title: aira caryophyllea subsp. cupaniana
intro: Aira caryophyllea subsp. cupaniana, commonly known as Cupani's oat-grass, is a perennial grass species. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and relieving anxiety and stress. The therapeutic actions of Cupani's oat-grass include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and sedative effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of insomnia and restlessness. The bioactive constituents of this plant are still being researched, but it is known to contain flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds with antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
